development_corrections: The first true-1581 run detected an unwanted CR after closing zero-byte output. Standard Commodore clswrt does this intentionally. Final copy preflights the source and rejects zero-byte IEC create before changing the destination; raw DOS references and the failed capture are retained.

The first unsupported-message literal used uppercase source letters, which 64tass encoded as high PETSCII. The CPU screen assertion and VICE complete-screen comparison rejected it. The final lower-case assembly text displays correctly.

An Ultimate short-write fixture assumed only a contiguous prefix; the existing native backend uses 511 bytes plus a final byte to avoid direct-sector corruption. The corrected test verifies exactly these two commands, retained 17 bytes plus the final byte, and no transfer replay.
The larger Files image requires more than the calculator test harness default 2-million-instruction budget. The desktop Files fixture now allows its disk load to complete.
A completed copy result is cleared when its destination changes; moving only the caret keeps the result.
report_metadata_correction: The CPU harness uses ci_native_heap.IMAGE, the workspace kernel. Its report initially named the desktop kernel digest. Only this digest was corrected after the passing run; the exact original report and executed test source are retained under preliminary/cpu-report-metadata. The maintained report now reads KERNEL_IMAGE. All cases, counts and other results are unchanged.
